substitution: Only Phi(predicted lane state10) becomes Phi(measured lane state10), including the PP branch. All nominal/t0 columns, fitted coefficients, scales and tie rules stay fixed.
averaging: Equal two states within seed, then equal ten seeds. All-action errors first average seven nonPP actions.
cost_units: 450-second mean halted vehicles per controlled lane
limitations: Measured future responses are unavailable at decision time. These readers were trained on inner-OOF predicted responses, so measured-response substitution changes their input distribution. No improvement does not prove that local true states lack information; improvement is not deployable or an upper bound. The score-error split is an algebraic identity, not causal shares. The original development HOLD remains unchanged.
